QUOTE: "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` (`src/inference/llama_cpp_tokenizer.cpp:55-63`) follows llama.cpp's two-phase API. The first `llama_tokenize` call passes a null buffer and size 0, so llama.cpp returns the negative of the required token count. The code negates it (line 58), allocates a vector of that size, and makes the second call to fill it."
